title: Coast Guard coordinates rescue of boater 330 nautical miles off Cape Cod
description: This video is of the disabled sailboat, Ishmael, 330 nautical miles east of Cape Cod, Wednesday, July 24, 2019. Rescue air crews from Coast Guard Air Station Cape Cod arrived on-scene to monitor the situation and deployed supplies to the person aboard. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Cape Cod)
